instances.brief: A fixture instance used only by schema tests.
instances.teaches: A range filter on an unindexed column forces a full table scan.

distractors.why_wrong: id is the primary key and the filter never references it.
A replica runs the same unindexed scan.

wrong_outcomes.shows: Query still returns in 4.1s, 4.1M rows examined.
wrong_outcomes.why_wrong: Nothing you changed affects how the planner reaches those rows.

instances.reveal: The planner has no ordered structure for created_at, so it reads every row and discards most of them. An index lets it seek to the range start and stop at the end.
